estimate: About 200 hours (PowerPyx) to 300+ hours (Push Square), difficulty 4/10, one playthrough, no online trophies, no mission replay.

stages.summary: Play all five chapters and take optional missions and character quests as they appear — many are only offered for a while, and there is no mission replay. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go, and turn on progress and collectible notifications in the settings.
tips: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before the chapter ends.
Scan vehicles (200 needed later) and study animals (100 needed later) while you travel.
Take the optional Chapter 4 mission That’s Where The Money Is… — it opens the bank-vault robberies.
Start Stranger strands as soon as they unlock; one outlet warns some have story-linked windows.
Never use cheats: GTABase and TechWiser report cheats disable trophies and saving.
stages.title: Play the story
stages.warning: MISSABLE — do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and meditate with her. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it as the only possibly missable step in the game.

stages.summary: After the credits, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work through what is left: every robbery, bank vault and gang operation, the underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks, plus 70 of the 80 challenges. The thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% of true completion — but it is still the longest stage and the hardest trophy, A Long Road.
tips: Work the checklist in the order it lists things; most miscellaneous trophies pop along the way.
You only need 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 50 of 66 weapons.
Launder Marked Bills after every robbery — Dime on the Dollar grows with the checklist robberies.
Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges and win a drone race at all 14 locations.
stages.title: The 100% Completion checklist

stages.summary: Finish the 8 Stranger mission strands (there are 14 in the game, so pick any 8), the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and Bret's hunt. Every quest giver tied to a trophy returns in free-roam after the story, so nothing here is lost by waiting — but do not leave it all until the end.
tips: Andy is Lucia-only; Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only — switch characters for their lines.
Finish any strand you started in Stage 1 before calling the run done.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and clean-up

stages.summary: Vice Got a Price! unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing left to do at this stage except check the list above and finish the last open trophy.
tips: If one trophy is missing, use the search box and the Missable filter to find it.
